english.title: Conspiracy to request, agree to receive or accept a bribe
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to request, agree to receive or accept a bribe
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(1), (2), (3) and (4) and 11 of the Bribery Act 2010 and section 1 of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
